item.title: Chinese Outbound Travel is Back, Just Not to Japan
item.description: As Chinese travel normalizes, destinations with friction, whether political or practical, are losing out to closer, easier alternatives in Asia.

item.title: Alaska Airlines Makes Its Largest-Ever Boeing Order
item.description: Alaska is ambitious about transforming itself from a West Coast player to an international one. The carrier hopes a blockbuster Boeing order will help it reach that goal faster.

item.title: Skift IDEA Awards 2026 Are Open: Find Your Category and Spotlight Your Innovation
item.description: Submissions are now open for the eighth edition of the Skift IDEA Awards, the travel industry’s most coveted achievement. Apply early to secure the best entry rate.

item.title: What Do New Year LinkedIn Posts from 11 Airline CEOs Tell Us?
item.description: Taken together, these seasonal messages offer a snapshot of how CEOs – or at least their communications teams – are framing their leadership and businesses after a bumpy year.

item.title: 3 Steps Airlines Could Take to Slash Emissions by 50%
item.description: With aviation still searching for real climate solutions, fewer luxury seats, fuller flights, and faster fleet upgrades have been proposed as ideas to help reduce emissions.

item.title: U.S. Expands Visa Bond Requirement to 38 Countries
item.description: Travel to the U.S. is getting harder for people from even more nations, which is the last thing the U.S. travel industry wants in what should be a banner year for tourism.

item.title: What Expedia’s Job Listings Reveal About Big Travel’s Next AI Phase
item.description: Expedia’s hiring signals a phase change for AI in travel, where management discipline and ownership matter as much as the technology itself.

item.title: Amadeus Moves Deeper Into Airline Commerce With Lufthansa Deal
item.description: Amadeus Nevio is anchoring Lufthansa Group’s retail overhaul, putting the travel tech company deeper into airline commerce — a higher-value role as order-based retail shifts from theory to execution.

item.title: Avelo Airlines Ends ICE Deportation Flights
item.description: Avelo’s CEO acknowledged the flights put it at the center of a “political controversy” but also said the business model wasn’t working.

item.title: How India Traveled in 2025: What the Data Shows
item.description: For Indians, travel decisions are no longer about what they are missing out. It is about who is valuing their business when they visit.
